name: Rain Over Glassline
description: The authored opening scene for a newly created character.

steps.title: ARES LOGISTICS PERIMETER // DAY 1 // 20:00
steps.text: Rain washes the Ares freight lights into pale bands. Two silhouettes wait beside the service entrance.

steps.title: A CITY YOU ALREADY KNOW
steps.text: You know which awnings hide a knife and which maintenance doors never quite latch. Glassline is cruel, but it has never been a mystery.

steps.title: THE VIEW FROM BELOW
steps.text: The tower credentials in your pocket expired months ago. The habits they bought you did not. Every camera angle still looks like an invitation.

steps.title: RESONANCE
steps.text: The signal should be noise. Instead, its harmonic structure follows the same impossible sequence you once found burned into an ether conduit.

steps.title: THE ARES JOB
steps.text: Rhea and Dax are in position. The service entrance is the first controlled threshold.

name: Static Beneath Glass
description: Mira recruits Vane to investigate the sealed annex.

steps.text: “The annex is eating people’s memories,” Mira says. “Sable heard the security band. We need her frequency map.”

choices.text: Take the job and go to the clinic

name: The Clinic Frequency
description: Information scene revealing the hidden station.

steps.text: Sable plays a recording: a human voice trapped beneath a corporate carrier signal.
The map exposes a forgotten station under Glassline and the service route into the annex.

outcome.title: A Route Beneath the Rain
outcome.resultText: The abandoned transit station is now visible on the district map.

steps.text: Ash Crow and two scavengers block the flooded platform. “Pay, turn back, or prove you are not corporate.”

outcome.title: A Narrow Accord
outcome.resultText: Ash parts with enough conductor to build a bypass spike.

steps.text: The old station opens into a cathedral of black glass. Ether-light moves behind the walls like something remembering how to breathe.
The core doors seal. Warden Kest raises a weapon, then hesitates as the ether signal speaks through every pane.
The recovered signal contains erased residents’ identities—and OmniCorp access keys worth a fortune.

choices.text: Sell the keys to the Syndicate

steps.text: Mira nods toward the safehouse. “Whatever we chose, Glassline will feel it by morning.”
By dawn the market whispers your decision. Sable arrives at the safehouse with a medical case and nowhere else to go.
Rain threads through the market holo-signs, turning every face into a shifting mask.
Names scratched into the station tile pulse faintly when the ether storm passes.
Sable quietly gives her last clean bandage to a child and pretends not to notice you watching.
Camera sweep is slow. We cross together, then stay below the rack lights.
Freight gate is our only route deeper. I will keep it open when we get there.

steps.title: WAREHOUSE PERIMETER
steps.text: The service door seals behind the team.
Office terminal is still live. A clean route pull could save us trouble at freight access.
Take what you need from the lockers. Past that gate, we do not stop.

steps.title: ROUTE CONFIRMED
steps.text: The stolen security route exposes a maintenance channel below the checkpoint.
Once the gate cycles, the perimeter cannot cover us. Stay close.
Charges are set. Your call opens the door.

steps.title: CHECKPOINT BREACH
steps.text: The freight lock disengages. Ares security moves on the far side.

name: Freight Checkpoint Lockdown
description: The sealed freight approach becomes the first serious fight of the operation.

steps.title: ACCESS ROUTE SEALED
steps.text: The gate slams shut behind the team. Two security officers spread across the loading lane while a sentry drone drops from its cradle.

steps.title: MAINTENANCE ANGLE
steps.text: The stolen route data exposes a protected loading recess. The team reaches cover before the firing line settles.
Gate is locked. We clear the lane or we stay here.
Drone first. I will keep the officers off you.

steps.title: ARES SECURITY ENGAGED
steps.text: The checkpoint opens fire.

name: Checkpoint Secured
description: The party crosses into the Ares inner facility after collecting the checkpoint supplies.

steps.text: The route advantage has served its purpose.

steps.title: INNER ACCESS
steps.text: The keycard releases the inner bulkhead. Rhea checks the dark corridor while Dax seals the damaged checkpoint behind you.

steps.title: ARES INNER FACILITY
steps.text: The team crosses into the security-damaged interior.

steps.title: NO EXTERNAL TRAUMA
steps.text: The personnel are dead where they fell. Armor is intact; there are no burns, wounds, or decompression signs. Damaged drones lie among them, destroyed by ordinary impacts.
The drones were fought. The people simply stopped. That is not the same cause.
No alarms in the bodies, no trauma. I want a clear path behind us.

steps.title: PROJECT PALIMPSEST
steps.text: Recovered files describe a contained interface that responds to attention, memory, and conscious expectation rather than conventional input.

steps.title: CONTACT TRIALS
steps.text: Every recorded subject was marked incompatible. The final reports stop before defining what compatibility would mean.
Ares kept asking it questions with living people. We still do not know what answered.
Whatever happened here passed through armor and walls. If either of us says stop, we stop.
I will hold the access line. You two read the chamber and come back out.

steps.title: VAULT ROUTE OPEN
steps.text: The last containment seal accepts the checkpoint keycard.

steps.title: CONTAINMENT CORE
steps.text: Inside overlapping magnetic frames hangs an object with machined edges and a surface that bends the chamber lights like deep water.

steps.title: SIGNAL WITHOUT SOUND
steps.text: The chamber tone stretches downward until sound becomes pressure. Motion separates into delayed images. The artifact seems closer each time you blink.
Do not let it notice that I am afraid.
If the seal fails, get them behind me.

steps.title: CONTACT
steps.text: Your hand meets cold alloy. Something on the other side meets the shape of your mind. Thought, command, memory, and silence become distinct pressures you can reach.

steps.title: CONTAINMENT FAILURE
steps.text: Sound returns as an alarm. The magnetic frames shear apart and the chamber floor lifts in a white concussion.
Move. I have the door.

steps.title: ESCAPE ROUTE // SECURITY RESPONSE
steps.text: The blast seals Dax behind the collapsing access frame. Rhea pulls you toward the emergency route as security units converge.

completionOutcome.title: Escape Combat Ready
completionOutcome.resultText: Dax is dead. The alarm is active, and the surviving pair must fight out of the vault.
